test_insecure_channel_connectivity: test creating an insecure gRPC aio channel and verify its initial IDLE connectivity state
test_channel_transient_failure: test that an unreachable gRPC channel transitions to TRANSIENT_FAILURE state without timing out
test_channel_ready_state: test that a gRPC channel connected to a running server transitions to READY state
test_channel_shutdown: test closing a gRPC channel and verify it transitions to SHUTDOWN state
test_channel_wait_for_state_change: test awaiting state changes on a gRPC channel and handle UsageError after shutdown
